title: Compare two quantities
description: A child adds one to an amount, then sees which of the two quantities is more. The page can show fractions, ratios, quantities, or before and after.
learningObjectives: Tell which of two quantities is more after one amount changes

params.description: Which kind of quantity the page shows.

events.name: quantity_changed
events.description: The child added one to a quantity.

events.name: comparison_made
events.description: The child compared the two quantities.

tutorGuide.intro: Both amounts start equal. Add one more, then say which quantity is greater.
observationPrompts: What changed when you added one more?

misconceptions.belief: The bigger colored blocks are more even when the count is smaller.
misconceptions.response: Count the filled blocks. The number, not the color, shows which amount is more.

hints: Tap Add one more, then read the sentence under the blocks.

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: Two amounts start equal. Activating Add one more increases one amount and states which is greater.
